newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains quiet, directionless.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains quiet, directionless.

text.p: Activity in the UK physical grains market was minimal, with many operators staying away in the last days before the holidays.
"There is no market...There's nothing to report," one said.
Levels for the few trades reported were close to traded prices seen Friday. There were no new features driving the market, traders said.
Feed wheat for January delivery in the Avon range was traded at 99 stg per tonne, with East Anglia done at 101 stg for January-March.
Milling wheat was reported traded at 119.50 stg for January- March to Liverpool.
Barley was traded at 99.50 stg for January and 100.50 for January-March, both in the Avon range and 102.50 for April-June to East Anglia.
